title: Music
simplified_paragraphs: 我喜欢音乐， 每天我都听很多音乐。 早上， 我在车里听音乐； 晚上， 我在家听音乐。 音乐是我的好朋友。
我的妈妈喜欢听慢的音乐， 爸爸喜欢听老的音乐， 姐姐喜欢听快的音乐， 这些我都喜欢。
因为喜欢听音乐， 所以我也喜欢唱歌。 我会唱很多歌， 我和我的好朋友经常一起唱。
我不会跳舞， 但是我觉得不会跳也没关系。
traditional_paragraphs: 我喜歡音樂， 每天我都聽很多音樂。 早上， 我在車裡聽音樂； 晚上， 我在家聽音樂。 音樂是我的好朋友。
我的媽媽喜歡聽慢的音樂， 爸爸喜歡聽老的音樂， 姐姐喜歡聽快的音樂， 這些我都喜歡。
因為喜歡聽音樂， 所以我也喜歡唱歌。 我會唱很多歌， 我和我的好朋友經常一起唱。
我不會跳舞， 但是我覺得不會跳也沒關係。
pinyin_paragraphs: wǒ xǐ huan yīn yuè，  měi tiān wǒ dōu tīng hěn duō yīn yuè。  zǎo shang，  wǒ zài chē lǐ tīng yīn yuè；  wǎn shang，  wǒ zài jiā tīng yīn yuè。  yīn yuè shì wǒ de hǎo péng you。
wǒ de mā ma xǐ huan tīng màn de yīn yuè，  bà ba xǐ huan tīng lǎo de yīn yuè，  jiě jie xǐ huan tīng kuài de yīn yuè，  zhè xiē wǒ dōu xǐ huan。
yīn wèi xǐ huan tīng yīn yuè，  suǒ yǐ wǒ yě xǐ huan chàng gē。  wǒ huì chàng hěn duō gē，  wǒ hé wǒ de hǎo péng you jīng cháng yī qǐ chàng。
wǒ bù huì tiào wǔ，  dàn shì wǒ jué de bù huì tiào yě méi guān xi。
english_paragraphs: I like music, I listen to a lot of music every day. In the morning, I listen to music in the car; in the evening, I listen to music at home. Music is my good friend.
My mother likes to listen to slow music, my father likes to listen to old music, and my sister likes to listen to fast music. I like them all.
Because I like listening to music, I also like singing. I can sing a lot of songs, and my good friends and I often sing together.
I can't dance, but I think it doesn't matter if I can't dance.
english_full:
I like music, I listen to a lot of music every day. In the morning, I listen to music in the car; in the evening, I listen to music at home. Music is my good friend.

My mother likes to listen to slow music, my father likes to listen to old music, and my sister likes to listen to fast music. I like them all.

Because I like listening to music, I also like singing. I can sing a lot of songs, and my good friends and I often sing together.

I can't dance, but I think it doesn't matter if I can't dance.
